question: Which State was founded by Nizam-ul-Mulk in 1724?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Hyderabad**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Hyderabad** was founded by Nizam-ul-Mulk in 1724.
 
• Nizam-ul-Mulk, also known as Asaf Jah I, established the Asaf Jahi dynasty, which ruled the state of Hyderabad.
 
• The state of Hyderabad became one of the most prominent princely states in India during British rule.
